body:
Industrial Distillation Tower & Distillation Column

Product Introduction

The Industrial Distillation Tower, also known as a Distillation Column, is essential equipment for separating and purifying liquid mixtures based on differences in component volatility and boiling points. Through controlled heating, vaporization, condensation, and vapor-liquid contact, it enables effective separation and recovery of various chemical components.

TONGYANG specializes in manufacturing customized distillation towers and chemical process equipment for petroleum refining, petrochemical processing, chemical manufacturing, and solvent recovery applications. Our equipment can be manufactured according to customer specifications, operating conditions, and applicable international standards.

Column Fabrication and Scope of Supply

Tongyang fabricates custom distillation columns from the mechanical design basis and approved project drawings. The agreed scope may include the column shell, heads, nozzles, support skirt, manways, reinforcement, lifting details, platform attachments and interfaces for trays or packing.

  • Trayed and packed columns: support rings, downcomer or packing support interfaces, distributors and related attachments are fabricated or coordinated according to the approved internals drawings.

  • Internals supply: trays, structured or random packing, distributors and demisters are included only where expressly specified in the supply list; a fabricated column does not automatically include every internal component.

  • Materials and corrosion protection: carbon steel, stainless steel, specified alloys and project-defined linings or cladding are reviewed against process conditions and fabrication requirements.

  • Transport planning: large columns can be reviewed for shipment in sections with agreed field-assembly interfaces, lifting points, fit-up provisions and inspection hold points.

Working Principle

Distillation towers separate liquid mixtures through differences in component volatility. Inside the column, rising vapor contacts descending liquid through trays or packing materials, allowing repeated mass transfer and progressive separation of components.

Two common operating methods include:

  • Atmospheric Distillation: Operates at or near atmospheric pressure and is widely used in petroleum refining and chemical separation.

  • Vacuum Distillation: Operates under reduced pressure to lower boiling temperatures, making it suitable for high-boiling-point and heat-sensitive materials.

Manufacturing & Quality Control

TONGYANG provides customized distillation tower fabrication services, including mechanical design, material procurement, welding, nondestructive testing (NDT), hydrostatic testing, surface treatment, and export packing.

With ASME U & U2 stamp capabilities, ISO-certified management systems, and experience in industrial pressure vessel fabrication, TONGYANG offers manufacturing solutions tailored to customer specifications and project requirements.

Technical Information for an Accurate Column RFQ

Please provide the process or mechanical data sheet, general arrangement and internals drawings where available. The key quotation inputs are column diameter and tangent-to-tangent height, head geometry, material and corrosion allowance, design pressure or full-vacuum condition, design temperature, nozzle schedule, support details, wind and seismic requirements, welding and NDE requirements, and transport or site-assembly limits.

The process designer's tray or packing selection, separation performance requirements and the division of design responsibility should also be identified so the manufacturing scope and interfaces can be priced correctly.
